question: Show sales by customer.
generated_sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) AS sum_total_amount, c.name FROM public.customers AS c INNER JOIN public.orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.name LIMIT 100
